name: prelo-booking
description: Prelo Booking — multi-tenant appointment platform for barbershops and beauty shops. Powered by JIE Mastery.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
